meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Python library for working with geospatial vector data including shapefiles, GeoJSON, and GeoPackage files. Use when working with geographic data for spatial analysis, geometric operations, coordinate transformations, spatial joins, overlay operations, choropleth mapping, or any task involving reading/writing/analyzing vector geographic data. Supports PostGIS databases, interactive maps, and integration with matplotlib/folium/cartopy. Use for tasks like buffer analysis, spatial joins between datasets, dissolving boundaries, clipping data, calculating areas/distances, reprojecting coordinate systems, creating maps, or converting between spatial file formats.

copy.tagline: 处理地理空间矢量数据，进行空间分析与制图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要处理 shapefile、GeoJSON 等地理数据并做空间分析
copy.tagline_en: Process geospatial vector data for spatial analysis and mapping
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with shapefiles, GeoJSON, or other vector geographic data for spatial analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Python 的 GeoPandas 库处理地理空间数据，比如读取 shapefile、GeoJSON 等文件，进行空间分析、坐标转换、地图绘制等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要处理地理数据，比如进行缓冲区分析、空间连接、裁剪、计算面积/距离、创建地图或转换文件格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GeoPandas 读取这个 shapefile 并绘制地图。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并生成地图。

say.text: 对这两个 GeoJSON 文件做空间连接，找出每个点所属的区域。
say.note: Claude 会执行空间连接操作。

say.text: 把这个 GeoPackage 数据投影到 EPSG:3857 并计算面积。
say.note: Claude 会进行坐标转换和面积计算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the GeoPandas Python library to handle geospatial vector data, such as reading shapefiles, GeoJSON, and GeoPackage files, performing spatial analysis, coordinate transformations, and map creation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to work with geographic data, such as buffer analysis, spatial joins, clipping, area/distance calculations, map creation, or file format conversion.

say_en.text: Read this shapefile and plot a map using GeoPandas.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and generate a map.

say_en.text: Perform a spatial join on these two GeoJSON files to find which region each point belongs to.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the spatial join.

say_en.text: Reproject this GeoPackage data to EPSG:3857 and calculate areas.
say_en.note: Claude will reproject and compute areas.
